messages:
maria: Hey team — new user hit a weird one during onboarding. starter repo 'hello-world' calls /v1/generate and it returns 200 but the client hangs waiting for streaming to finish. logs show a short JSON with 'billing_ack_required' and then a connection close.

kevin: can you paste the full response body? looks like our SDK may be treating that as a successful response but not emitting final chunk.

maria: pasted snippet (sanitized):
```
{"id":"resp_123","status":"partial","detail":"billing_ack_required","message":"Org needs billing contact acceptance","streaming":false}
```
then socket closes, app never gets full message. user saw a success in dashboard for a token count but no output in the sample app.

kevin: hmm, the 'streaming\":false' and 'status\":"partial\"' combo is odd. Is this a Hosted API call or Dedicated?

maria: hosted. region us-west. user said they just accepted invite and workspace shows 'billing_required' in UI.

jordan: @kevin tagging infra — we had a change where non-fatal gating responses returned 200 with a special body instead of 402 in some edge cases. Might be leaking through SDK streaming path.

kevin: repro steps requested. maria, can you ask the user for raw curl? Also which SDK and version? we had a fix in js-sdk 1.4.3 for treating non-200 bodies as terminal events.

maria: user sent curl (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"open-7b","input":"hi"}'
```
response headers: `content-type: application/json`, `content-length: 123`, then the body above and connection reset. SDK: js 1.4.1.

kevin: OK that matches. js 1.4.1 had streaming code that assumes 200==streaming body; it didn't check for 'detail': 'billing_ack_required'. The server should probably use 402/403 for gating, or the SDK should handle that sentinel.

maria: user asked why dashboard shows usage if call didn't produce text. billing-bot? @billing-bot any idea?

billing-bot: This workspace is in 'billing pending' state. We optimistically record the request footprint at accept-time for quota but do not allow content generation until billing contact accepts charge terms. The event gets logged as 'queued' which can look like usage in some quick views.

jordan: two action items: (1) server: return 402 with a structured error for billing gating (2) SDK: treat the 'billing_ack_required' sentinel as an error and emit a final error event so apps don't hang.

kevin: I'll cut a patch for js-sdk (1.4.4) to detect body.detail == 'billing_ack_required' and error out. Also add tests for streaming false + partial status.

maria: for immediate customer unblock, can we tell them a workaround?

kevin: tell them to accept the billing invite (workspace admin) or use a workspace with billing enabled. For service accounts, we can set the header `X-Bypass-Billing-Check: true` for internal tests (only works for org-internal tokens). NOT for prod.

maria: sending workaround now. user accepted billing contact and retry worked. they got streaming text. :tada:

jordan: filing infra ticket to change server response code and adding telemetry to catch these partial-success cases. ticket #INF-4582.

devex-bot: deploy notification: js-sdk@1.4.4 published (patch) — includes billing sentinel handling and streaming test coverage.

maria: thanks all. can we add a small FAQ blurb in the onboarding guide about 'billing acceptance may prevent first call' so CS has a playbook?

kevin: good idea — I'll PR a short section and link to the ticket.

maria: will close after PR + infra fix. many thanks! :coffee:
